company_overview: Postman provides an API platform that lets users design, test, manage, and distribute APIs throughout the entire API lifecycle. It streamlines collaboration and adds governance, AI‑assisted features, and enterprise‑scale capabilities.
target_audience: Engineers and developers building, testing, and operating APIs and services, especially within enterprise environments.

company_overview: Supabase provides an open‑source Postgres‑based development platform that offers a managed database, authentication, realtime, storage, edge functions and vector search as a unified backend. It enables developers to launch full‑stack applications quickly and scale them to production‑grade workloads.
target_audience: Developers and teams building web, mobile or AI‑powered applications—including startups, enterprises and innovation teams—who need a ready‑to‑use Postgres backend with integrated services.

company_overview: Vapi provides a platform for building, deploying, and managing advanced voice AI agents that handle calls, support, and other interactions. The service offers enterprise‑grade infrastructure, real‑time monitoring, and compliance features such as SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI.
target_audience: Enterprises and developers building voice‑based AI agents for customer support, lead qualification, appointment scheduling, and other call‑center use cases.
